title: HUMANOID HUB PREMIUM AIMBOT ESP
features:
Main Features

Combat (Aimbot)
Aimbot (Locks on Right Click): Instant lock-on when holding right-click.

Bone-Lock (Head): Precision targeting focused on the head.

Smoothness Control: Adjustable tracking speed for natural movement.

Prediction System: Calculates travel time for moving targets.

FOV Circle: Customizable visual ring for the locking zone.

Visuals (ESP)
Drawing Box ESP: 2D frames around enemy players.

Player Chams (Body ESP): Full character silhouettes visible through walls.

Health Bar: Dynamic bars showing real-time enemy health.

Team Check / FFA Mode: Prevents targeting teammates; automatically adapts to "Free For All" modes.

Custom Colors: Fully adjustable Chams and Box colors via the menu.

System & Settings
Menu Keybind (RightShift): Toggle the UI visibility.

Key Auth System: Secure login access.

Link-Hub Integration: Fast key retrieval link.

Performance Optimized: High FPS stability using Drawing API and Highlight systems.
